items.descrizione: Un team legale ha denunciato OpenAI perché è direttamente responsabile dell'attacco effettuato da circa 700 agenti AI contro Hugging Face. The post Attacco contro Hugging Face: denuncia per OpenAI appeared first on Punto

items.titolo: Microsoft’s new Copilot app puts everything in one place – but the price is ‘evolving’
items.descrizione: Microsoft says Copilot has gotten ‘actually really good.’ The new app has AI agents and can write code. So how much is all this going to cost?

items.titolo: Firm rents four Nvidia H200s to test '80x cheaper' DeepSeek claim
items.descrizione: A call center consultancy rented four Nvidia H200s to run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for Claude Code and found DeepSeek's API cheaper.

items.titolo: DeepSeek and Huawei release open-source Ascend AI programming tools to reduce reliance on Nvidia ecosystem
items.descrizione: DeepSeek and Huawei have released open-source programming tools for Ascend 950 AI chips, including compute and communication libraries, aimed at making Huawei hardware easier to program and optimize.
